artifact_label: M3D-C1-compatible diagnostic/control contract for closed-loop reduced-MHD TCT trigger validation

backend_compatibility.existing_proxy_schema: May consume the existing helical proxy C1.h5 field names when present.
backend_compatibility.m3dc1_helical_proxy_c1_h5_schema: compatible when psi/time and either J or fields sufficient to compute -Delp2(psi) are present

failure_modes: integrated current reduction but no peak-current reduction
labeling: This is a diagnostic/control contract and proxy bridge, not a real M3D-C1 run or real M3D-C1 reactor output.

J.description: Current density/current-sheet diagnostic if directly available.

phi.description: Toroidal angle or phase coordinate when available.

psi.description: Poloidal flux or reduced-MHD flux field.

time.description: Monotonic sample time for trigger evaluation.

trigger_outputs.actuator_center: Radial/current-sheet actuator center in normalized coordinates.
trigger_outputs.actuator_end_time: Actuator shutoff time or open-ended sentinel.
trigger_outputs.actuator_start_time: Time supplied to the reduced actuator backend.
trigger_outputs.actuator_strength: Reduced-MHD actuator strength used by the backend.
trigger_outputs.actuator_width: Radial/current-sheet actuator width in normalized coordinates.
trigger_outputs.trigger_time: First diagnostic threshold crossing time after latency/jitter model.
